description: Reverse-ETL sink: mirror an upstream DataFrame into Trello cards in a target List. Rows are matched to existing cards by a key marker embedded in the card description (e.g. <!-- dagster-key: INC-1001 -->); Trello has no native upsert endpoint for cards.

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row -> one Trello card (upserted via key_column).

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (rows_created / rows_updated). No downstream data -- write side effect lands in Trello.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with source.

source.label: Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql/csv/inline). Mutually exclusive with upstream_asset_key.

list_id.label: List Id
list_id.description: Target Trello List ID cards are created/matched in.

key_column.label: Key Column
key_column.description: Upstream column holding a stable unique key, embedded as a dagster-key marker in the card description.

due_column.label: Due Column
due_column.description: Column holding an ISO-8601 due date/datetime.

id_labels_column.label: Id Labels Column
id_labels_column.description: Column holding Trello label IDs to apply. Accepts a list, or a comma-separated string.

closed_column.label: Closed Column
closed_column.description: Column holding a boolean/'true'/'false' to archive (close) the card.

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Max upstream rows to process per run (safety cap).

name: Trello Card Upsert
